prompt:
Redraw this photograph as a clean, final, high-resolution editorial plate with the same composition, framing and lighting: a cutaway section of a hotel staff room set into a granite cliff, framed by rough stone above and below — pale wooden lockers along the back wall, a small wooden table with dark chairs and a candle, a potted plant, a small service cart, a slim vertical orange-glowing lift core at the right, and small plants on the rock at the left. Remove the round orange dot on the table. Keep every element where it is, and fit the scene to a landscape 3:2 frame. Sharpen the wood, stone and metal detail to the finest level.
No text, letters, numbers, logos, lines, dots or UI. No people.
